sesion.explicacion: With a session, what you log goes up to the server and what is there comes down here. Without one, everything lives in this browser. The token is asked once and swapped for a cookie this code cannot read.
sesion.abierta_explicacion: The log is kept in this browser and the queue uploads it to the server.
sesion.atascada: There is a write the server will not take: {motivo}
sesion.quedan_por_subir: {n} still to upload: if you sign out now, they will not go up.

bolsas.vacio: You have no bags yet. Every coffee that comes into the house is a bag —with its roast date and its own clocks— and every brew is logged against one: start the first with “New”.
bolsas.nota_restante: The grams left come from subtracting the doses you {registradas}. If you brew without writing it down, they overestimate what is left.

recetas.vacio: There are no recipes left, and without at least one the timer has nothing to guide. Create one with “New”.

portada.sin_api: Could not reach the API. If you are offline, this will show the last saved data once the app is installed.
portada.que_es: A log of V60 brews: you record every cup changing {una_cosa} at a time, and the app suggests what to adjust next.
portada.opinionada: It is opinionated — Tetsu Kasuya's 4:6 method and thresholds calibrated against its author's palate — and your data lives {solo_aqui}: no accounts, nothing sent to any server. By the same token, backing up is on you: the footer has the backup.
portada.crono_explicacion: The three 4:6 recipes come ready; with a bag added, the timer guides your pours and the log takes care of the rest.
portada.como_instalar: This browser is not offering the dialog. Look for it in its menu (⋮) as “Install app” or “Add to home screen”. If you have just updated the app, reload once and try again.
portada.respaldo_nunca: You have been logging for {dias} day with no backup at all. | You have been logging for {dias} days with no backup at all.
portada.respaldo_viejo: Your last backup is {dias} day old. | Your last backup is {dias} days old.
portada.respaldo_solo_aqui: : your data only exists in this browser.

defecto.orden_pista: All of them stay on the record, but the adjustment comes from the first one only ({principal}): fix what bothers you most and measure again. If the second is still there, it will be first next time.

tabla.sin_previa: There is no earlier brew to compare against: this is the first one.
tabla.dos_a_la_vez: Two variables at once: the data will not be good for comparing. Log it if you want, but knowing that pair will say nothing.

pasos.bascula_no_vale: the scale is no good here
pasos.referencia: The pours add up to {agua}, which is the reference water: if you brew with another amount, they scale proportionally.

preparar.medicion_a_medias: You have a measurement half done.
preparar.sin_bolsas: You have no open bag: the brew will be logged with no bag and will not compare with anything.
preparar.sin_recetas: There are no recipes left, and without one the timer has nothing to guide.
preparar.restablecer_ojo: There is a timed brew and it will be lost. That cannot be measured again: the coffee is already brewed.
preparar.restablecer_alternativa: If what you want is to log that cup, {vuelve} and record it.

reloj.bascula_no: Do not look at the scale: the spoon weighs while it is in there.
reloj.en_pausa: Paused · tap the circle to carry on
reloj.toca_para_empezar: Tap the circle when you start pouring
reloj.inicio_del_paso: Back to the start of the step
reloj.goteo_medido: Drawdown: {n} s, measured on its own
reloj.sin_querer: That was a slip: keep counting
reloj.reiniciar_ojo: The timed brew is lost, and that cannot be measured again: the coffee is already brewed.
reloj.reiniciar_alternativa: If that cup deserves to be on the record, log it before restarting.

bolsa.copiado_de: Copied from {nombre}: what changes with every bag is missing —roast date, purchase, price and photo—. The id comes from the server.
bolsa.no_existe: There is no bag with id “{id}”.
bolsa.quitar_foto_ojo: This one is deleted for good, there is no bin: if you want it back you will have to upload it again from your phone.
bolsa.id_fijo: id {id} — cannot be changed: it is the key the brews point at.

receta.fuente_no_existe: There is no recipe “{id}”: the form comes up empty.
receta.reemplazan: On saving, the steps replace the ones that were there. Brews already logged do not change: they saved their own {reparto}.
receta.borrar_ojo: This one has no bin like the brews do: the recipe and its steps go, and there is no way back. If any brew used it, the server will refuse.

ajustes.crono_intro: How it warns you about each step while you brew.
ajustes.sonido_pista: Three pips before each step and a tone when it starts.
ajustes.cuenta_atras_pista: Three seconds to pick up the kettle, on resume too.
ajustes.latido_pista: The number grows with every warning: visible even on silent.
ajustes.tema_intro: On automatic it follows whatever your phone is set to.
ajustes.donde_viven: Settings are kept in this browser. With a session open they travel to the server and come down to your other devices.

respaldo.que_es: A ZIP with the whole log: bags, recipes, brews and photos, in the same CSVs the repo keeps. It works as a copy and as a move to another browser.
respaldo.ninguno: You have not downloaded one yet.
respaldo.persistente_si: The browser has marked this storage as persistent: it will not clear it to make room.
respaldo.persistente_no: The browser does not promise to keep this storage forever. Installing the app helps; the backup is the guarantee.
respaldo.con_sesion: With a session open, the good copy is the server: restoring here would have no effect, because the next refresh would bring the server's back. Restoring is for local mode.
respaldo.reemplaza: Restoring {reemplaza} what is in this browser with whatever the backup brings. It does not merge: what is here now goes.
respaldo.restaurado: Restored. The log is now the one from the backup.
respaldo.reemplazara: It will replace what is here now — {cafes}, {recetas} and {extracciones} — and there is no way back.

alta.del_crono: Time and drawdown come from the timer.
alta.sin_bolsa_aviso: With no bag the cup is on the record, but it compares with nothing and adds to no history. If this coffee is going to come round again, {enlace}: on saving you come back here with it selected, and what you wrote is not lost.
alta.vuelves_atras: You are going back to an earlier one: the deltas are measured against it and not against the last, which is what makes this a single change and not two.
alta.movido_goteo: The drawdown moved with it: drawdown runs inside the total, not alongside.
alta.movido_tiempo: The total time moved with it: drawdown runs inside the total, not alongside.
alta.retencion: The bed keeps {n} g of water per gram of coffee
alta.desde_bolsa_previa: The values come from the last brew of the previous bag ({fecha}{abierta}). The roast is another one, so this counts as a first brew and is not compared with that one — and those settings may be compensating for a coffee already gone flat.
alta.desde_cualquiera: The values come from your last brew ({fecha}{cafe}). It is another coffee, so it is not compared with it: the grinder and the hand are the same, nothing more.
alta.desde_suelta: The values come from your last brew with no bag ({fecha}). Every bagless cup is a different coffee: they are not compared, this is just the starting point.
alta.vaciar_ojo: There is a timed brew and it will be lost. That cannot be measured again: the coffee is already brewed.
alta.vaciar_resto: The rest —temperature, clicks, recipe— takes a moment to type again.
alta.conforme: Balanced and well scored: touch nothing, repeat to confirm.

extraccion.no_existe: There is no brew at that address.
extraccion.madre_ninguna: None: this one starts a series
extraccion.bolsa_no_existe: Does the bag not exist yet? {enlace}: on saving you come back here with it selected.
extraccion.retirar_que_pasa: It is not deleted: it stays marked and stops counting for the suggestions. It can be restored.
extraccion.retirar_ojo: Only withdraw {errores}. If you remove the brews that came out badly, the averages rise on their own and the paired deltas stop meaning anything.
extraccion.hijas_una: {n} brew hangs from this one: withdrawing it leaves that one with nothing to compare against, and it starts counting as a first.
extraccion.hijas_varias: {n} brews hang from this one: withdrawing it leaves them with nothing to compare against, and they start counting as firsts.
